actions.name: search_im_messages
actions.description: Search IM Messages. This API searches IM messages and returns message list-view details with an embedded session per result. Use searchStr or message to filter by text. Use from and limit to paginate results. Use sortBy and sortOrder to control result ordering.

from.description: Index number, starting from which the messages must be fetched.

limit.description: Number of messages to fetch. Defaults to 50 when omitted or zero. Maximum value is 50.

sortBy.description: Sort messages by created time or status updated time.

searchStr.description: Search keyword applied across message and conversation fields. Supports wildcard suffix with asterisk.

sessionId.description: Filter messages by session IDs. Comma-separated list of session IDs.

departmentId.description: Filter messages for channels in the given department.

channelId.description: Filter messages by channel IDs. Comma-separated list of channel IDs.

channelType.description: Filter messages by channel integration service. Comma-separated list. Possible values: TELEGRAM, TWILIO, IM_TALK, LINE, WECHAT, WECOM, WHATSAPP, FACEBOOKMESSENGER, INSTAGRAM.

agentId.description: Filter messages sent by agent IDs. Comma-separated list of agent ZUIDs.

botId.description: Filter messages sent by bot IDs. Comma-separated list of bot IDs.

deskContactId.description: Filter messages by desk contact IDs. Comma-separated list of contact IDs.

contactProfileName.description: Filter messages by contact profile name.

participantId.description: Filter messages by participant IDs. Comma-separated list of participant IDs.

participantType.description: Filter messages by participant type. Comma-separated list. Possible values: AGENT, BOT, ENDUSER.

messageType.description: Filter messages by message type. Comma-separated list. Possible values: TEXT, INFO, ATTACHMENT, LOCATION, TEMPLATE, CAROUSEL.

metaType.description: Filter messages by meta type. Comma-separated list. Possible values: DESK_TICKET_ID, DESK_TICKET_NUMBER.

metaValue.description: Filter messages by meta value. Example format: DESKTICKET|123458.

convoCreatedTimeRange.description: Filter by conversation created time range. Enter dates in ISO format: yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ,yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ.

convoUpdatedTimeRange.description: Filter by conversation updated time range. Enter dates in ISO format: yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ,yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ.

createdTimeRange.description: Filter by message created time range. Enter dates in ISO format: yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ,yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ.

updatedTimeRange.description: Filter by message updated time range. Enter dates in ISO format: yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ,yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ.

include.description: Additional information related to the requests. Values allowed are: createdBy and modifiedBy. You can pass multiple values by separating them using commas in the API request.

from.description: Index number, starting from which the requests must be fetched.

status.description: Processing status of the request. Values allowed are: INITIATED, INPROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELED, EXPORTED, PARTIALLY_COMPLETED, PARTIALLY_EXPORTED and FAILED. You can pass multiple values by separating them using commas in the API request.

startTime.description: Starting time of the time range in which the requests should have been created. The time should be in the UTC time zone and expressed in a timestamp.

endTime.description: Ending time of the time range in which the requests should have been created. The time should be in the UTC time zone and expressed in a timestamp.

requestType.description: Filter by type of the request. Values allowed are: ACCESS_REQUEST, ERASURE_REQUEST. You can pass multiple values by separating them using commas in the API request.

actions.description:
Search Tickets. This API searches for tickets in your help desk.
You can provide multiple values separated by commas, and the search will be performed on the field using any of the provided values.

Learn more about search and how it works.

email.description: The corresponding email address associated with the ticket. example: 1. email=jack* 2.email=${notempty} 3.email=${empty} !@wildcard search@! !@empty check@! !@not empty check@!

phone.description: The phone number provided in the ticket !@wildcard search@! !@empty check@! !@not empty check@!

accountName.description: Name of the account associated with the ticket !@wildcard search@! !@empty check@! !@not empty check@!

departmentId.description: ID of the department from which the entity must be fetched. If the ID is not passed, then searches in all permitted departments !@exact match@!

productName.description: Name of the product associated with the ticket !@wildcard search@! !@empty check@! !@not empty check@!

_all.description: Key that includes all the columns in the tickets module for search !@wildcard search@!

limit.description: Specifies the number of tickets to be fetched. !@default : 10@!

from.description: The starting index for fetching results. !@default : 0@! !@starts from 0@!

dueDateRange.description: Key that filters tickets due in a particular period of time. !Enter the from and to dates in the ISO date format of yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ;! !For example,! dueDateRange=2017-11-05T00:00:00.000Z,2018-09-05T23:59:00.000Z

productId.description: ID of the product associated with the ticket !@exact match@!

contactId.description: ID of the contact who raised the ticket !@exact match@!

createdTimeRange.description: Key that filters tickets created in a particular period of time. !Enter the from and to dates in the ISO date format of yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ;! !For example,! createdTimeRange=2017-11-05T00:00:00.000Z,2018-09-05T23:59:00.000Z

items.description: Priority of the ticket

assigneeId.description: ID of the agent who is assigned to resolve the ticket !@exact match@!

items.description: ID of agent to whom the ticket is assigned

modifiedTimeRange.description: Key that filters tickets modified in a particular period of time. !Enter the from and to dates in the ISO date format of yyyy-MM-ddThh:mm:ss.SSSZ;! !For example,! modifiedTimeRange=2017-11-05T00:00:00.000Z,2018-09-05T23:59:00.000Z

status.description: Status of the ticket inclusive of custom status. example: 1. status=open,in progress 2. status=${open}  !@exact match@!

pattern.description: Expression that combines this branch's conditions by index (1 is the first condition). Criterion 1 must be ANDed at the root -- for example (1 and 2) or (1 and (2 or 3)). A single condition may be just 1. Root OR patterns such as (1 or 2) are invalid; use multiple fieldConditions branches instead.

name.description: Name of the field condition block

condition.description: Operator used for the condition. Valid operators depend on the field type: text, picklist, and lookup support is, isn't, starts with, contains, doesn't contain, ends with, is empty, is not empty; date supports is, isn't, is after, is before, is empty, is not empty; dateTime additionally supports between and not between; integer and currency support =, <>, <, <=, >, >=, is empty, is not empty; boolean supports is. Call Get Criteria Fields for Validation Rules to get the exact operators allowed for a specific field.

fieldName.description: API name of a module field used in the condition. The field must exist on the module. For lookups, use the flat field API name.

value.description: Value(s) used for the condition. For lookup fields, pass the related record display name, not the record ID. For is empty and is not empty, the value is the ${EMPTY} or ${NOTEMPTY} token. dateTime conditions may use ${CURRENTTIME} in place of a timestamp. Boolean fields use true or false.

alert.description: Alert message shown when the condition block matches

displayLabel.description: Display Label of the primary field to be used for creating the rule

executeInHelpCentre.description: Indicates whether the validation rule can be executed in Help Centre. Possible values: true = validation rule can be executed in Help Centre; false = validation rule cannot be executed in Help Centre.

status.description: Activation status of the validation rule. Possible values: active, deactive.
